# pugixml

Upstream: https://github.com/zeux/pugixml/tree/v1.15
Version: 1.15 (MIT, see LICENSE.md).

Only the parser implementation, public header and configuration header are bundled.
OfficeIO uses in-memory XML parsing with DTD rejection, node/depth and byte limits.
No filesystem loader, external entity resolver or network request is invoked.
Trailing whitespace and final blank lines may be normalized for the repository.
